lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The corridor door. Shut, as doors are, and your card still opens it.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: The quarter is not closed. I am not walking out on an open quarter; I have never once done that.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The door, and behind it a corridor lit end to end. The card reader is dark. The door is not locked; it simply no longer belongs to you.

choices.text: Go. Down the stairs, out the service side, up the valley road.
